summary: Join our Succession Planning for Oil and Gas Leadership Training Course. Equip yourself with essential skills to ensure a smooth transition in leadership roles.
lede: Oil and gas succession planning is the process of identifying critical roles and preparing talent to fill them. Designed for HR, talent, workforce-planning and operational leaders, the course covers role assessment, talent mapping and individual development plans. It also addresses knowledge transfer for technical continuity and governance of succession decisions.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for senior professionals and decision-makers responsible for the long-term human capital stability of energy organizations.
audience: Talent Management Lead in integrated energy companies
Workforce Planning Specialist focused on energy sector
Learning and Development Manager for technical
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in human resources, talent management, or operational leadership within the energy sector. A basic understanding of organizational structures and performance management systems is required. No prior experience with ISO 30409 is necessary, as this will be covered in the curriculum.
